Name: Level 3 Cohort 6 Beta Night
Description: Come one, come all to the Level 3 Beta Night! After a successful Alpha Night and debut of the 8 games that are being created in Level 3, they have taken in your playtest feedback and are ready to show you all how they have leveled up their games. Come by to meet the team and help playtest their betas!

Name: Level 1 Cohort 13
Description: In our introductory weekend long bootcamp we give you the very first tools you'll need to break into the game industry. Spend a total of 8 hours of live lessons learning from game professionals on multiple important topics. Learn the fundamentals of Design, Production, and the Godot Game Engine: just enough to help you get started building games regardless of your desired path.

Name: Level 3 Cohort 7 Applications
Description: IGA Cohort 7 Begins June 4th, 2024. Classes are Tuesday and Thursday at 6:30pm EST - 8:30pm EST and continue until September 19th, 16 total weeks of class, 4 months. The ticket price of the program is $3400, but scholarships can bring that down as low as $800. Payment plans are available to all.Applications close May 27th  at 11:59pm EST. The earlier you apply the more likely you are to receive a scholarship. (We will consider late applications at our own discretion)
